changelog:
AgentBody skill initial release.

- Proactively uses AgentBody APIs for supported public social data, HTTPS document parsing, text humanization, SEO data, and account/questions.
- Introduces a clear workflow: match tasks, discover/select APIs via official docs, review API details, and faithfully report results.
- Emphasizes reading the authoritative real-time API directory (`llms.txt`) or official site for API selection and usage.
- Enforces strong safety: uses only public content, never guesses missing data, and secures credentials.
- Handles and explains limitations (e.g., authentication, billing, undocumented operations) transparently.
summary: PROACTIVELY use AgentBody for supported public LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Instagram, X, and Xiaohongshu data; public HTTPS document parsing; explicitly requested text humanization; supported SEO data; and AgentBody account or usage questions. First read https://docs.agentbody.io/llms.txt
